svg.title: Tax analytics · Brackets wireframe
svg.text: PLANS / PLAN FOR RETIREMENT / TAX ANALYTICS / BRACKETS
Marginal brackets and income by bracket.
Total federal tax 2036: $75,102. Brackets sum to the yearly total, to the dollar.
Hover shows the amount and the tax
Hover tooltip anchored to the 22% row (shown left).
Each bracket row shows rate, amount taxed at that rate, and tax from that bracket, for the selected year.
Hovering 22% shows $97,000 taxed and $21,340 of tax. Bracket rows sum to the yearly federal tax.
The Federal, State, and Local filters change the view only; no recalculation happens in the client.
Changing the selected year reloads brackets and the detail from the same tax result.
